title: Representatives of BSU named after K. Karasaev took part in the International GDU Conference in OshSU

blocks.text: On May 15–16, 2025, the International Scientific and Practical Conference “Creation of the National GDU Network: Tasks and Ways of Their Implementation” was held at Osh State University within the framework of the Erasmus+ GREENKG project.
From Bishkek citystateK. Karasaev National University The conference was attended by:
Rahat Rai kyzy, Coordinator for International Relations and Communications,
Alymkul Orozaliev, Head of the Department of Geography, Tourism and Natural Sciences,
Almas Mamytov, Head of the Department of State and Municipal Service.

Participants discussed the implementation of green and digital practices in universities, the development of student initiatives and the creation of the National Network of Green and Digital Universities (GDU). The conference included plenary speeches, section sessions, master classes, excursions and the approval of a plan for the development of the GDU network.
